added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: the report states 'only 7 share three or more' windows while the node's own delivered clones.log prints pairs_ge3_windows=0 and clones.json has max(shared_windows)=1 over all 135736 pairs, so the sentence a reader would quote is unsupported by the data shipped beside it; the 202 cross-file containment==1.0 helpers themselves reproduce exactly.

T5's two supporting counts do not reproduce under the commands it cites: at 4aca668aa grep -rln '/proc/' tests/*.py is 36 (report says 43) and grep -rn 'subprocess.run|subprocess.Popen' tests/*.py is 977 (report says 993), so a conftest-narrowing plan sized from these numbers uses the wrong population; the non-count claims (17 autouse fixtures, 1231-line conftest) reproduce.

T4 claims '60 sites in 40 test files' but the 60 sites live in 24 files naming inspect.getsource or __file__).read_text (47 if the ast.parse( union is counted); no reading of the cited command yields 40.

T2 pairs the number 35 with grep -l installed_browser_or_skip tests/*.py, which yields 29; 35 is the set importing the browser harness. The substantive claim (223-test browser population, 72 always skipping) reproduces from browser-probe.log (151 passed, 72 skipped).

T4 cites line 150 as asserting "_drain_row" in inspect.getsource(promotion._unreconciled_live_runs); line 150 asserts runs.drain and the named object is on line 151, an off-by-one citation for the example a reader would open to judge the finding.
